decisions.reason: Having retained this focused seventy-two-hour express program while dropping weaker adjacent delivery formats, the firm can build on its existing production and service knowledge, read demand more clearly, and improve the offer as a scalable premium service.

This fire-resistant steel exterior door remains closely tied to the firm's strongest technical and regulatory knowledge base, and its approval-backed fit with the core portfolio gives the firm high capacity to refine and commercialize it further.
